LearningState.title: LearningState
LearningState.description: Synchronized learning state for an authenticated Marketolog Academy account (active course, lesson, completed slugs, learning mode, quiz attempts, and active module tabs).

activeCourseSlug.description: Currently selected course slug or empty string when cleared

activeLessonSlug.description: Most recent lesson slug in the active course or empty string

activeCourseUpdatedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when the active course selection was last updated

completedAtBySlug.description: Map of lesson slug to completion unix ms timestamp

lastViewedAtBySlug.description: Map of lesson slug to last viewed unix ms timestamp

quizAttempts.description: Map of attemptKey to serialized quiz attempt fields

activeModulesByCourse.description: Map of courseSlug to currently expanded module ID

clientUpdatedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp from latest mutation for cross-device merge

/learning_states/{stateId}.description: Protected server-vaulted learning progress state keyed by server-side cryptographic document ID
